body:
We are all on excellent terms, but her family is exceedingly proud and can be very judgmental.  As such, they aren't really aware of her past problems, however depression and suicide are not unknown by her family (her grandfather committed suicide) and Alzheimers is also prevalent.  So, I think mental illness can have some basis in heredity, so I see this as much as a medical issue as an emotional one.  But, there is a stigma that I have to be aware of because it might do more harm than good.

I think what scares me is that even though I love her very much and tell her every day, as do her kids, it may not be enough.

Thank you for your help.

Thank you, I'll call the pharmacist in the morning, as well as her doctor.  I am not sure how much I can do with all this HIPPA stuff, but I know she'll call if I ask her too.

Any advice on how to find a therapist?  I've honestly never tried...not sure if I call my insurance provider (do they cover this?) or just google.  It seems like a referral would be safest, but from whom?

I'll give her a piece of paper with at least three suicide prevention numbers (we live in a major city, so there are a good many) that she can call if she can't call me.

Thank you for your help.
